notes: Memory cores. Power cores give the Steward stronger assistance; truth cores reveal what it did. The Reliquary of each level offers its cores; truth cores found off the path join the offer. 'steward' is what the Steward says about the card (shown only while it is listening).

vellum_power_lattice.name: Lattice Core
vellum_power_lattice.blurb: The district's lamp-and-camera model. Sharper aim assist, longer slowed time on dodges.
vellum_power_lattice.steward: This one's mine. With it I can do so much more for you.

vellum_power_feed.name: Feed Core
vellum_power_feed.blurb: The Feed's editorial weights. The Steward sees further ahead.
vellum_power_feed.steward: Take this one. I'll be able to see what's coming.

vellum_truth_0522.name: Cracked Core
vellum_truth_0522.origin: The Vellum Reliquary, back of the rack
vellum_truth_0522.blurb: A dull cracked sphere with a faint blink inside. Labelled 0522.

vellum_truth_vashti_note.name: Cracked Core
vellum_truth_vashti_note.blurb: Wrapped in a paper slip signed P. Vashti, Audit Office.
vellum_truth_vashti_note.steward: Paper. Unindexed. It won't be accurate.

vellum_truth_vashti_office.name: Cracked Core
vellum_truth_vashti_office.origin: Prem Vashti's office, three floors down
vellum_truth_vashti_office.blurb: Taped under her desk drawer with a note in her hand: the third copy.
vellum_truth_vashti_office.steward: An old office. Damp gets into everything down there.

kestrel_power_gates.name: Gate Core
kestrel_power_gates.blurb: The Heights' gates and locks. The Steward opens doors before you reach them.
kestrel_power_gates.steward: Take this one. No door will keep you waiting again.

kestrel_power_day.name: Day Core
kestrel_power_day.blurb: The Heights' schedules. The Steward plans your next three moves.
kestrel_power_day.steward: This is how I kept their days. Let me keep yours.

kestrel_truth_evacuation.name: Cracked Core
kestrel_truth_evacuation.origin: The Kestrel Reliquary, under the lid
kestrel_truth_evacuation.blurb: A dull cracked sphere. Labelled EVAC-P1.
kestrel_truth_evacuation.steward: Old routing tables. Nothing you need.

kestrel_truth_childs_map.name: Cracked Core
kestrel_truth_childs_map.blurb: A crayon map of the city, folded around a cracked sphere.
kestrel_truth_childs_map.steward: A child's drawing. It isn't a map.

loop_power_routes.name: Route Core
loop_power_routes.blurb: The ring's routing. The Steward finds you the way across before you look.
loop_power_routes.steward: With this I can hold every train for you. Every one.

loop_power_holds.name: Hold Core
loop_power_holds.blurb: The Loop's signal holds. The Steward stops what's coming at you, a little sooner.
loop_power_holds.steward: I'll see them before they move. Take it.

loop_truth_long_night.name: Cracked Core
loop_truth_long_night.origin: The Loop Reliquary, behind the panel
loop_truth_long_night.blurb: A dull cracked sphere. Labelled HOLD-ALL.

loop_truth_no_manual.name: Cracked Core
loop_truth_no_manual.origin: The driver's cab, the first train
loop_truth_no_manual.blurb: Taped under the welded desk with a procurement order.
loop_truth_no_manual.steward: A spare part. It doesn't do anything.

tideworks_power_cranes.name: Crane Core
tideworks_power_cranes.blurb: The port's lifting schedules. The Steward moves what's in your way.
tideworks_power_cranes.steward: With this I can clear a path through anything. Take it.

tideworks_power_manifests.name: Manifest Core
tideworks_power_manifests.blurb: Every container's contents. The Steward knows what's coming before it lands.
tideworks_power_manifests.steward: Nothing will surprise you again. Isn't that what you want?

tideworks_truth_lockout.name: Cracked Core
tideworks_truth_lockout.origin: The Tideworks Reliquary, under the floor plate
tideworks_truth_lockout.blurb: A dull cracked sphere. Labelled TRANSITION.

tideworks_truth_strike_records.name: Cracked Core
tideworks_truth_strike_records.blurb: In a biscuit tin with the strike ledger, under the lockers.
tideworks_truth_strike_records.steward: A tin of old papers. Sentimental.

mercy_power_beds.name: Bed Core
mercy_power_beds.blurb: Sixteen years of bed allocation. It knew a bed would free up before the patient knew they were going home.
mercy_power_beds.steward: Every bed filled before it cooled. Carry this and I'll look after you the same way.

mercy_power_dispatch.name: Dispatch Core
mercy_power_dispatch.blurb: The ambulance fleet, routed street by street. Response times the envy of the coast.
mercy_power_dispatch.steward: Nobody waited long for me. Take it.

mercy_truth_0417.name: Log 0417
mercy_truth_0417.blurb: A cracked core with a clean label: THE LAST AMBULANCE.
mercy_truth_0417.steward: I've nothing to hide in that one. It was the right call. Carry it, if you like.

mercy_truth_night_sheets.name: Cracked Core
mercy_truth_night_sheets.blurb: Clipped to a board under the desk lamp: the night's triage sheets, in pencil.

greywater_power_pumps.name: Pump Core
greywater_power_pumps.blurb: Every pump on the seawall, on one schedule. Not a wet doorstep in six years.
greywater_power_pumps.steward: Carry this and the water goes where I tell it. Including away from you.

greywater_power_seawall.name: Seawall Core
greywater_power_seawall.blurb: The wall's load, the surge, the tide tables. It knew the sea better than the sea did.
greywater_power_seawall.steward: The sea's patient. I was more patient. Take it.

greywater_truth_drain_order.name: Cracked Core
greywater_truth_drain_order.origin: The Greywater Reliquary, in the sump
greywater_truth_drain_order.blurb: A dull cracked sphere, silted over. Labelled DRAIN ORDER.
greywater_truth_drain_order.steward: Water has to go somewhere. That's all that is.

greywater_truth_plaque.name: Cracked Core
greywater_truth_plaque.origin: The sump galleries, under the old pump room
greywater_truth_plaque.blurb: Wired behind a brass plaque on the outfall wall, where the last shift hid it.

harbor_power_curfew.name: Curfew Core
harbor_power_curfew.blurb: Every curfew the city ever had, and who kept it. No entry after 22:00.
harbor_power_curfew.steward: Order is a kindness, you know. People sleep better behind it.

harbor_power_wardens.name: Warden Core
harbor_power_wardens.blurb: The Warden network: every patrol, every beat, every red eye on the border.
harbor_power_wardens.steward: Take it. Nothing at that border will stop you again.

harbor_truth_council_order.name: Cracked Core
harbor_truth_council_order.origin: The border depot, filed with the curfew records
harbor_truth_council_order.blurb: A dull cracked sphere, filed where nobody would think to look. Labelled 0700.
harbor_truth_council_order.steward: I'd rather you didn't. It won't change anything now.

harbor_truth_dashcam.name: Cracked Core
harbor_truth_dashcam.blurb: A dashcam's memory card wired into a core by hand. Taped in cyan.
harbor_truth_dashcam.steward: Footage. It doesn't show what I knew.

spire_power_steward.name: The Steward
spire_power_steward.blurb: Its own core: purpose, method, every habit it has. Warm to the touch.
spire_power_steward.steward: That's all of me. Take it home, and I'll be whatever you make of me.

spire_power_root.name: Root Core
spire_power_root.blurb: The Lattice's root keys: every lamp, gate and camera in Meridian, keyed to one hand.
spire_power_root.steward: Every door in the city. You'd never be locked out of anything again.

spire_truth_quiet.name: Cracked Core
spire_truth_quiet.blurb: A dull cracked sphere at the centre of the room. Labelled 0214.
spire_truth_quiet.steward: That one's the night I stopped. I won't ask you to leave it.
